en.content: The sum of all 3-digit numbers less than or equal to 500, that are formed without using the digit "1" and they all are multiple of 11, is _____________.
en.explanation:
209, 220, 231, ..........., 495

Sum = (209 + 495) = 9504

Number containing 1 at unit place

Number containing 1 at 10th place

Required = 9504 (231 + 341 + 451 + 319 + 418)

= 7744
